title: HS50016: Financial Modelling
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS30082/HS30097; HS41002 and BM60011Course ContentsIntroduction
to Financial Modelling; Types of Financial Models; Model Specifications;
Hypothesis Testing; Interpretation of Results; Determinants of Capital
Structure; Pecking Order Hypothesis; Corporate Investment Function; Dividend
Policy- Determinants; Working Capital Determinants; Financial Market
Integration; Volatility in Financial Markets; Determinants of Interest Rate;
Exchange Rate Determination; Testing CAPM Models; Testing APM Model;
Determination of Stock Returns in India; Why Companies go Public?; Factors
affecting under pricing IPOs; Implications of Financial Modelling.
